definitions.explanation: Investigating something deeply to understand its nature or the truth about it: the work of scientists, scholars and curious students. Written with {究|きゅう} (to get to the bottom of).

examples.japanese: ⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探究|たんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{探究心|たんきゅうしん}→探究心：05793_tankyuushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: She has a strong spirit of inquiry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{探究|たんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: In our high-school inquiry class, we researched the history of our area.

notes:
Since the 2022 curriculum, Japanese high schools teach a subject called ⟦{総合的|そうごうてき}→総合的：06175_sougouteki⟧な{探究|たんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧, in which students pick a question and research it themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探究|たんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to inquire into the truth
- ⟦{探究心|たんきゅうしん}→探究心：05793_tankyuushin⟧: spirit of inquiry, curiosity
- {探究学習|たんきゅうがくしゅう}: inquiry-based learning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{探求|たんきゅう}→探求：12902_tankyuu⟧: quest, pursuit — seeking something one wants (happiness, ideals); {探究|たんきゅう} is investigating to understand
- ⟦{追究|ついきゅう}→追究：32046_tsuikyuu⟧: pursuing a question to the end
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: research, the everyday word
